```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", dpi = 300)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

source(here::here("scripts/R/functions/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02"),
  funs = c("report_format"),
  packages = c("here", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "scales", "dampack"),
  set_knitr = FALSE,
  set_theme = FALSE
)
```

```{r data, include=FALSE}
cache_file <- here("data", "tidy", paste0("psa_obj_", utility_source_label, ".rds"))
psa_obj <- if (file.exists(cache_file)) readRDS(cache_file) else NULL
ceac_data <- if (!is.null(psa_obj)) dampack::ceac(seq(0, 150000, by = 2000), psa_obj) else data.frame()

```

```{r figure, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
if (nrow(ceac_data) > 0) {
  ceac_data <- ceac_data %>%
    filter(Strategy %in% names(strategy_labels)) %>%
    mutate(Strategy = factor(strategy_labels[Strategy], levels = strategy_labels))

  p_ceac <- ggplot(ceac_data, aes(x = WTP, y = Proportion, color = Strategy)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.85) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = WTP, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray40") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 100000, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray65") +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_currency(prefix = "EUR ", scale = 0.001,
                                                       suffix = "K")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Standard of Care" = "gray50",
                                  "CRP-guided" = "#E69F00",
                                  "TMB/BRAF-guided" = "#0072B2")) +
    labs(x = "Willingness-to-pay threshold (EUR/QALY)",
         y = "Probability cost-effective",
         color = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  print(p_ceac)
} else {
  cat("PSA cache not available.")
}
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
if (exists("p_ceac")) {
  figs_dir <- here("figs")
  if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  ggsave(here("figs", "figure_s4.png"), p_ceac, width = 9, height = 6,
         dpi = 300, bg = "white")
}
```

Figure S4 has been saved to `figs/figure_s4.png`.
